description.text: Mega Battle Deck 60: M Audino-EX, a ready-built 60-card Fairy deck released on 18 March 2016 together with the Zygarde-EX Perfect Battle Deck. It gave Mega Audino its first card, built around Audino-EX and M Audino-EX with Audino Spirit Link. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a rule book and a player's guide came with it.
